name: light__brightness_via_engine
description: LevelControl cluster (0x0008) attribute CurrentLevel (0x0000) on endpoint 4 emits ReportData on a fresh bridge-initiated exchange when the subscription engine drains a dirty mark. Complements cover__level_via_engine to confirm that the F4 fix is not cluster-specific: any (cluster, attribute) pair registered with the subscription manager triggers the correct fresh-exchange path through the engine-tick pipeline.
